youtube_description:
http://arizonaderm.com/team-member-positions/nurse-practitioners/#tirsa-quartullo

Tirsa Quartullo is a doctoral prepared, board certified family nurse practitioner. Tirsa earned her bachelor’s degree from the University of Buffalo in 1999. She also earned her master’s degree from the University of Buffalo in 2002, with honors. She was inducted into Sigma Theta Tau, the international nursing honor society. Tirsa continued her education by pursuing her doctoral degree from Rocky Mountain University in Provo, UT after accepting the university’s presidential scholarship. In 2009, she earned her Doctor of Nursing Practice degree, focusing her studies and dissertation in dermatology-based research.
